result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both use the same cues for Studio: a 'Most popular' badge, an accent border and a filled button. B fits the whole section in the frame. Its one-line heading sits well under the prices, and the dark ghost buttons on Starter and Network make those cards clearly quieter. A's heading runs to two very large lines that rival the prices, and the bottom of its cards is cut off, so Studio's last feature isn't visible. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both use the same pattern for Studio: a 'Most popular' badge, a coloured border, a slight lift and a filled button, with large prices in every card. A's heading is better proportioned: it is a single line and doesn't compete with the Studio card. B's heading wraps to two lines at close to price size, and its cards run past the bottom of the screenshot. B's outlined buttons make Starter and Network a little more usable than A's very dark ghost buttons, but overall A's hierarchy is more balanced.
